description:
Use this when the user wants to know what their better posts have in common: "why did that one do well",
        "what should I do more of", "what makes my clips work". Looks at the user's own posts of the last `days`
        (default 90) that have a day of views and compares views at 24 hours by clip length, caption length, platform,
        weekday, time of day (in the IANA timezone given, e.g. America/Chicago) and a title set on the post. Returns the
        biggest gaps with how many posts are in each group and how likely each gap is to be luck, plus a plain warning
        when there are too few posts (under 10 it compares nothing). These are differences in the data, never proof of
        a cause: say so.
        Not for: predicting views of a new clip, posting hours (best_time_to_post) or a recap (weekly_report). Free and
        read only.
name: why_it_worked
title: Why it worked
